2023_059_ki_elementary.paragraph: A bundled set of KI furniture quotations issued to Troy School District for the "2023 Pilot Furniture" project, with one quotation per elementary building covering Barnard, Bemis, Costello, Hamilton, Hill, Leonard, Martell, Morse, Schroeder, Troy Union, Wass and Wattles. All are priced under Contract Information line OT8142CZ1, Sourcewell #121919-KII, delivered and installed through dealer The Interior Group of Milford, Michigan, and all carry Opportunity #624468. Quote totals range from $2,852.01 for Martell Room 13 to $23,773.24 for Wattles, with Morse at $22,682.31 and Leonard at $13,700.22. Most were created 2/24/2023 and revised between 3/15/2023 and 3/17/2023, valid through 4/25/2023.

Nature of the item
A package of KI (Krueger International) quotations prepared for Troy School District's "2023 Pilot Furniture" program, one quote per elementary building, each listing classroom-by-classroom seating and soft-seating packages with per-line sell prices, extended totals, finish options and manufacturing lead times.

Product mix
Seating is drawn from the Intellect Wave family: IW415 4-Leg Chair, Medium at $96.39; IW415C 4-Leg Chair w/Casters, Medium at $135.07; IW418 4-Leg Chair, Large at $101.15; IW418C 4-Leg Chair w/Casters, Large at $141.61; IWPD15 Task Chair, Medium, Polypropylene at $171.36; IWPD18 Task Chair, Large, Polypropylene at $184.45; IWS Task Stool, Large, Polypropylene at $217.18. Frames are Starlight Silver Metallic /SX with Blue Grey /PGR No Fire Retardant shells. Tables and soft seating include CMDGA2026-73P C-Table Max, 26" fixed height, 20"x26" worksurface at $371.48 with Kensington Maple 10776-60 laminate; MPRB/CGL/FC MyPlace Rectangle w/Back at $1,513.24; MPSQRL/CGL/FC MyPlace Lounge Chair at $1,092.77; TSCH3618CH Tattoo Storage Chest, 36"Wx18"D at $850.41 (at $848.16 on the Troy Union quote); and TSPD1218MF Tattoo Mobile Pedestal at $362.70 on the Bemis quote. Upholstery is KI Ordered Material from DESIGNTEX in Alphabet Pool 3877-403 or Alphabet Cobalt 3877-405 at $45.00 per yard and Tilt Peacock 3001-902 at $95.00 per yard, compliant with TB 117-2013 and carrying a California Proposition 65 antimony trioxide warning.

Terms
Delivery, freight, off-loading and installation are included as one install trip to one location during normal business hours; storage and removal of existing items are excluded. Orders must ship within 120 days of KI receiving the order, and purchase orders must be issued to KI at the Green Bay address with full line-item detail; a signed quote is not accepted as a PO. Manufacturing lead times run 2-4 to 4-6 weeks from Green Bay, WI; 4-6 weeks from Pembroke, ONT; 5-7 weeks from Bonduel, WI; and 6-8 weeks from High Point, NC.

Common commercial terms. Delivery, freight, off-loading and installation are included as one install trip to one location during normal business hours, covering receiving, unboxing, inspection, assembly, staging in the rooms and removal of packaging debris; storage and removal of existing items are excluded, and extra costs apply if an elevator is unavailable, stair carry is required, or dock, floor, staging and power access are inadequate. Tax-exempt customers must have a certificate on file with KI's Finance Department; Estimated Sales Tax reads "See Notes" and is calculated at order entry. Orders must ship within 120 days of KI receiving the order. Purchase orders must be issued to KI or KI c/o the dealer at the Green Bay address with full line-item detail; a signed quote or worksheet is not accepted as a purchase order, incomplete POs are held, and customers without a formal PO process may call 1-800-424-2432. Sales are governed by the terms at www.KI.com/terms, and upholstery carries a California Proposition 65 antimony trioxide warning while complying with TB 117-2013. Lead-time summaries list Green Bay, WI at 2-4, 3-5 or 4-6 weeks depending on the quote, Pembroke, ONT at 4-6 weeks, Bonduel, WI at 5-7 weeks and High Point, NC at 6-8 weeks, calculated on the respective revision dates and subject to change.
